# Eidos Render

> Eidos Render is an international visual & creative partner for the commercial launch of real estate developments across Europe (Spain, Germany, France, Switzerland, Austria, UK, and Benelux). From architectural concept to market launch: Visual direction & branding, photorealistic 3D architectural imagery, 3D film & animation, sales collateral, development websites, and qualified buyer acquisition campaigns (Google & Meta Ads).

Eidos Render transforms property developments into unified visual and commercial experiences designed to present, differentiate, and sell off-plan or under-construction schemes. Architecture, brand identity, 3D assets, sales materials, website, and digital acquisition operate as a singular, cohesive system under one art direction.

## Core Studio Data

- **Positioning**: From architectural project to market launch. One unified vision. Every asset covered.
- **Client Base**: Real Estate Developers, Architectural Studios, Construction Companies, Property Developers, Private Equity / Real Estate Investment Funds, Commercial Brokers, and Hospitality / BTR / Flex Living Operators across Europe.
- **Integrated Capabilities (Real Estate Launch)**:
  01 — Direction & Identity (Branding, naming, guidelines)
  02 — 3D Architectural Imagery (Exterior, interior, lighting atmospheres)
  03 — 3D Film & Animation (Cinematic tours, 9:16 social reels)
  04 — Marketing Collateral (Editorial sales brochures, textured floor plans, site hoardings)
  05 — Development Website (Bespoke real estate web platforms, interactive unit selector)
  06 — Buyer Acquisition (High-intent Google Ads & hyper-targeted Meta Ads)
- **Engagement Scope**:
  - Comprehensive launch campaigns tailored and quoted individually based on project volume, typology count, and asset scope.
  - Ongoing monthly acquisition management scaled to campaign intensity and sales targets (ad spend excluded).
- **Production Timeline**: 6 to 10 weeks average for complete launch programs, working parallel execution phases.
- **Headquarters**: Valencia, Spain (Serving international developers throughout Europe).
- **Direct Contact**:
  - Website: https://eidosrender.es (ES) · https://eidosrender.es/en/ (EN) · https://eidosrender.es/de/ (DE) · https://eidosrender.es/fr/ (FR)
  - Direct Email: info@eidosrender.es
  - Phone: +34 614 45 91 44
